title: TOP AUXILIARY- HEADLINER & TRIM
summary: Convertible (19467) with the C07 auxiliary removable hardtop: the hardtop headliner (chart-headliner assembly) and the inside trim molding across the rear window opening. The headliner is held by push fasteners at the front and rivets along the sides; the rear molding has a stud of its own (no separate callout) that goes through the roof flange and takes a nut from inside, plus a screw at the end. Related sheets: A2, A3.
